item.title: Team Documentation (GDrive vs. Markdown)
item.summary: How does your team manage your team documentation? At work we use Google Docs and its MCP, and most of my colleagues use Codex to write any documents. For my side projects, we use markdown in repo mostly. Curious what your team uses for primary documentation for day to day work.
